title: fix(plugin-security): the RLS write check judges a date / datetime / time column in its stored form
body:
Fixes #21109
Clause-②: no

Executes ruling A (comment 5933322270 on #21109): **the RLS write check judges the row as it will be stored.** Dispatched by the `domain:services` seat 2 PM under claim 5938708535, session `session_01DiCSbmJrkzNhuEAier4VoJ`.

## What changed

- New `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/rls-check-stored-form.ts`. Its `storedFormCheckJudge` is the one step every write-check path passes through before `matchesFilterCondition` judges a `check` clause. That covers the insert seam, the by-id update image and the update seams, since all of them call `satisfiesCheck` in `security-plugin.ts`. On each column the object **declares** `date`, `datetime` or `time` (the spec's `CALENDAR_DATE_TYPES`, `INSTANT_TYPES`, `CLOCK_TIME_TYPES`), it puts two things through `@objectstack/core`'s `temporalStorageForm`, which it consumes and does not change:
  - the post-image's value;
  - the check's value comparands on that column (`$eq`, `$ne`, the four orderings, `$in`, `$nin`, `$between`, implicit equality).
- The declared types come from the declaration the write check already reads (`writeCheckFieldOptions` → `declaredComparisonColumns`), never from the values. A column the object does not declare temporal is judged as written. An object whose schema cannot load is judged as before.
- Refusals are still attributed to the compiled policies as they are (`checkParts`). The rewritten parts are used only for evaluation, and they are copy-on-write: a filter with nothing temporal comes back as the same object.
- `security/explain` does not judge a `check` clause. It judges fetched, stored rows under the read filters (`explain-engine.ts:1088`), so it is not on this step.

## Measured (ObjectQL.insert + SecurityPlugin + SqlDriver on better-sqlite3, as a member resolving a permission set; the same predicate as `using` and `check`)

Compiled filters are shown instead of the CEL text.

| compiled check | written | `main` 62b90d74 | this PR | stored | read |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{ due_on: { $lte: '2026-01-05' } }` | `'2026-01-05T15:00:00Z'` / `Date` / `'2026-01-05'` | admitted ×3 | admitted ×3 | `2026-01-05` | shown |
| `{ due_on: '2026-01-05' }` | `'2026-01-05T15:00:00Z'` | **403** | admitted | `2026-01-05` | shown |
| `{ due_on: '2026-01-05' }` | `Date(2026-01-05T15:00Z)` | **403** | admitted | `2026-01-05` | shown |
| `{ due_on: { $gt: '2026-01-05' } }` | `'2026-01-05T15:00:00Z'` | **admitted** | 403 | `2026-01-05` | hidden |
| `{ due_on: { $lt: '2026-01-05' } }` | `'2026-01-04T23:00:00-05:00'` | admitted | admitted | `2026-01-04` | shown |
| `{ start_time: '09:00' }` | `'09:00'` | admitted | admitted | `09:00:00` | shown |
| `{ start_time: '09:00' }` | `'09:00:00'` | **403** | admitted | `09:00:00` | shown |
| `{ due_at: { $gte: '2026-01-05T10:00:00Z' } }` | `'2026-01-05T10:00:00Z'` | admitted | admitted | `2026-01-05T10:00:00.000Z` | shown |
| `{ due_at: '2026-01-05T10:00:00Z' }` | `'2026-01-05T18:00:00+08:00'` | **403** | admitted | `2026-01-05T10:00:00.000Z` | shown |
| `{ tags: { $contains: 'x' } }` | `'x'` | 403 | 403 (not folded, below) | `["x"]` | shown |
| `{ tags: { $contains: 'x' } }` | `'xy'` | 403 | 403 | `["xy"]` | hidden |

On every temporal row, this PR admits a write exactly when the read shows the stored row. The one write that is admitted on `main` and refused here is the `$gt` boundary-day cell, whose stored row the read hides. The changeset names it as the read/write agreement the ruling buys.

## The comparand half (beyond the ruling's literal words)

The ruling names the post-image. Putting only the image into the form would **refuse writes `main` admits and the read shows**, whenever a policy spells its comparand unlike the stored form. Ablation A2 below measured two such writes: `{ due_at: { $gte: '2026-01-05T10:00:00Z' } }` written with that same instant, and `{ start_time: '09:00' }` written as `'09:00'`. The read pairs both sides (`driver-sql`'s `coerceFilterValue`, the memory driver, objectql's `having` walker), so the step pairs both sides too. This is called out for the seat's confirmation in the report.

## Not folded: the multi-valued scalar wrap (claim 5938708535's condition)

The condition: the wrap must come from the same function the write door uses. That function is `normalizeMultiValueFields`, at `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts:599`. It cannot be reached without a new export in another lane's package:

- neither entry of `@objectstack/objectql` exports it (`index.ts:404` exports `ValidationError`, `validateRecord`, `VALIDATION_FAILED_CODE`; `core.ts:90` exports `ValidationError`, `validateRecord`);
- `plugin-security` lists `@objectstack/objectql` under `devDependencies` only.

So the fold is not built, and nothing is copied. Still measured (table above): `tags: 'x'` under `contains('x')` is 403 while the read shows `["x"]`. The insert seam runs at `engine.ts:13253`, before `normalizeMultiValueFields` at `:13410`. The export a fold needs, and the options, are in the report.

## Fork clause: driver-mongodb

The SQL family (`driver-sql`, `driver-sqlite-wasm`, `driver-turso`) and `driver-memory` call `temporalStorageForm`. `driver-mongodb` stores through its own copy (`mongodb-temporal.ts`). Shape by shape, over 15 shapes, the two give the same logical value. A `datetime` is the same instant held as a BSON `Date`, a physical spelling of the kind ADR-0053 keeps for MySQL. The one exception is a `Date` in a UTC year from 0001 to 0999 on a `date` column: core gives `0999-06-15` and the copy gives `999-06-15`. On `main`, the raw check already admits that write under a bare-day `$lte` (the `Date` is lifted to an instant). Mongo's own read of `999-06-15` against any padded day sorts it above that day whatever RLS does. This PR treats that as a mongo defect, not a fork in the stored form, and reports it to the seat to rule. A live mongod is NOT MEASURED: no binary in the container.

## F7 stays

`lteBound` (`packages/formula/src/matches-filter.ts:902`) stays live and untouched: `git diff 62b90d74..HEAD -- packages/formula` is empty. Its deletion is the follow-up card the seat files after this lands. The pins here already pass with it out of reach (below). The RLS CEL lowering emits no `{ $field, addDays }` comparand: `cel-to-filter.ts` has 0 `addDays` hits, against 5 `$field` hits as the control. That half of F7 is therefore the deletion card's to measure on its other callers.

## Tests

- `rls-check-stored-form.test.ts`, 38 cells, on two driver families (driver-sql better-sqlite3 and driver-sqlite-wasm):
  - 16 write-and-read cells: each write is admitted exactly when the read under the same predicate shows the stored row (`PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 asserted as code + status), and a refused write stores nothing. They cover `date` (the boundary day as an ISO instant, a `Date` and a bare day), `datetime`, `time`, and a `text` control.
  - A by-id update cell.
  - 3 unit cells: the declaration-only column reading, comparand rewriting, and copy-on-write.
  - **F7 is out of reach in this file.** `@objectstack/formula`'s matcher is wrapped so a `$lte` arrives as `$lt` or `$eq` (and a `$between` as `$gte` plus that), and the first cell pins that the wrapper is live.
- At head 00cb5519: `vitest run` for plugin-security gives **157 files, 3383 passed, 23 skipped** (the new file is +1 file / +38 tests). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` exits 0: `tsc --noEmit`, the scripts project, and `check:test-typecheck` OK with 0 debt.

## Ablations

All on committed head ec6db40d, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode. Every restore is proven: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Tests import `src` directly, so no `dist/` was involved.

| | mutation | red of 38 |
|---|---|---|
| A0 | the judge swapped back to `main`'s raw evaluation | 16: per driver, `$lte` ISO + `Date` (F7 out of reach), `$eq` ISO + `Date`, `$gt` boundary, `datetime` +08:00, `time` `'09:00:00'`, by-id update |
| A1 | image half off | 16: as A0, except `time` `'09:00'` written replaces `'09:00:00'` |
| A2 | comparand half off (image only) | 8: `datetime` `==` +08:00, `datetime` `$gte` same spelling, `time` `'09:00'`, `time` `'09:00:00'`. Two of these are admitted on `main` and shown by the read |
| A3 | a `text` column read as `date` | first attempt a **no-op** (the tool refused: the replacement contained its anchor, count 1 → 1); rerun with the anchor `return undefined;`: 7, both control cells on both drivers plus the 3 unit cells |
| A4 | the judge admits everything | 14: exactly the 7 negative pins × 2 drivers |

## Gates

- Derivation: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at 00cb5519 gives 63 families from 4 paths vs merge base 62b90d74f. All 63 were run with exit codes recorded, and all exited 0. `--ran`: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The first sweep, at 1d9ccecf, had three non-zero exits:
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). Both passed after a full turbo build (72/72).
  - `check:test-source-alias` exited 1: a dynamic `import('@objectstack/formula')` inside a test body. Fixed in bfa3609f (a module-top import).
- Narrowed lint at 00cb5519: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 3 changed `.ts` files gives 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, none ignored. The population comes from `eslint.config.mjs:971` (`files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}']`). `eslint.config.mjs:327-329` enables no type-aware linting, so no untouched file's verdict can move. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Control-byte self-scan over the changed files: none.

## Docs

I grepped `content/docs/**` (outside `releases/`) and `skills/**` for sentences on how a `check` judges a write (raw versus stored form, date columns), and found none this PR makes false. Positive control: the grep reaches `content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx:64` (the `check` row: each row as its hooks leave it) and `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx:56` (`check` judges the write post-image). Both are still true. No docs edit.

## Acceptance notes

- `security/explain` compares a stored row against a `using` comparand as written. A temporal comparand spelled unlike the stored form (for example `'09:00'` on a `time` column) would be compared unlike the read. This is unmeasured, so it is noted and not filed.
- The multi-valued wrap and driver-mongodb's unpadded year go to the seat as findings in the report.
